tasks.prompt: Fresh combinatorics task. From the set [5, 6, 7, 9, 23, 24, 25, 32], choose exactly 3 distinct values. Adjacent values in sorted chosen order must differ by at least 2, and the chosen sum must be from 39 through 62, inclusive. Count all valid subsets and give the lexicographically smallest valid subset in ascending order. You may reason before the answer. End with exactly one line beginning FINAL_ANSWER:, followed by one JSON object and no trailing text. Required JSON keys and value types: count (integer), witness (list of integers).
